notes: A follower brought back from the Relapse Zone (Second Chance, Phoenix Rising, Promise of Tomorrow, Never Forgotten, Back on Track, One Day at a Time, Recovery Call) now correctly returns as its base, non-evolved self instead of keeping its evolved bonus stats and badge.
fixes: Followers revived from the Relapse Zone no longer keep their evolved bonus stats/badge -- reviving a follower now correctly returns it to its base, non-evolved form.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
